title: 申爱无界 2025上海马拉松本周日鸣枪起跑
claims: The 2025 race starts at 07:00 on 30 November with three waves; the wheelchair race starts at 06:45.
Because of the three-wave start, the overall cut-off was extended by 15 minutes to 13:30.
Pre-registrations reached 356,589, and the marathon ballot success rate was 7.2%.
About 43 elite athletes were invited, including 18 international elites; the wheelchair field was expanded to 19 athletes.

Aid stations: drinks every 5 km from 5 km; water every 5 km from 7.5 km; nine energy stations from 12.5 km offering bananas, chocolate, small cakes and SiS gels; six ice stations; eight spray stations.
Race pack collection runs 27-29 November, 09:30-19:30, at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, 850 Bocheng Road.
The start area adds 10 additional men's toilets to reduce pre-race queues.
The race is broadcast by Dragon TV and Great Sports and streamed on multiple platforms.
